checks.title: Exported component without permission protection
checks.expected_secure_behavior: Components that are not meant for other apps are android:exported=false; exported components are guarded by a signature-level permission.
checks.remediation: Set android:exported="false" on internal components and add android:permission (protectionLevel signature) to components that must be exported. Explicitly declare android:exported on every component with an intent-filter.

owasp: OWASP Mobile Top 10 2024: M8 Security Misconfiguration

checks.title: Application is debuggable in manifest
checks.expected_secure_behavior: Release builds do not set android:debuggable=true.
checks.remediation: Remove android:debuggable from the manifest (build tooling sets it per variant) and verify release variants are not debuggable.

owasp: OWASP Mobile Top 10 2024: M7 Insufficient Binary Protections

checks.title: Application data backup enabled
checks.expected_secure_behavior: android:allowBackup is false, or backup rules exclude sensitive data.
checks.remediation: Set android:allowBackup="false" or define android:fullBackupContent / dataExtractionRules that exclude tokens, databases and credentials.

owasp: OWASP Mobile Top 10 2024: M9 Insecure Data Storage

checks.title: Cleartext (HTTP) traffic permitted
checks.expected_secure_behavior: The app only communicates over TLS; cleartext traffic is disabled globally.
checks.remediation: Remove android:usesCleartextTraffic="true" and cleartextTrafficPermitted="true"; serve all endpoints over HTTPS and scope any exception to a specific dev-only domain.

owasp: OWASP Mobile Top 10 2024: M5 Insecure Communication

checks.title: WebView with JavaScript enabled exposes JS bridge or file access
checks.expected_secure_behavior: WebViews load only trusted content and do not combine JavaScript with addJavascriptInterface or file-URL access.
checks.remediation: Avoid addJavascriptInterface for untrusted content, disable setAllowFileAccess and file-URL universal access, restrict navigation to an allowlist of HTTPS origins and annotate bridge methods with @JavascriptInterface only where needed.

owasp: OWASP Mobile Top 10 2024: M4 Insufficient Input/Output Validation

checks.title: Insecure local storage (world-accessible files, plaintext secrets in SharedPreferences)
checks.expected_secure_behavior: Files use MODE_PRIVATE and secrets live in the Android Keystore or EncryptedSharedPreferences.
checks.remediation: Never use MODE_WORLD_READABLE/WRITEABLE; store tokens and passwords with EncryptedSharedPreferences (Jetpack Security) or Keystore-backed keys, and avoid persisting passwords at all.

owasp: OWASP Mobile Top 10 2024: M9 Insecure Data Storage

checks.title: Runtime certificate-pinning bypass and instrumentation resistance review
checks.expected_secure_behavior: Pinning and tamper checks hold when the app is run under an instrumentation framework on an authorized test device.
checks.remediation: Implement pinning via network security config pins, add layered integrity checks and document what is accepted risk. Test only on authorized devices with the owner's consent.

checks.title: Intent fuzzing of exported components
checks.expected_secure_behavior: Exported components handle malformed or malicious intents without crashing or leaking data.
checks.remediation: Validate all intent extras and URIs, use explicit intents internally and fix crashes or data exposure found by fuzzing the exported surface on an authorized test device.
